references.text: A man who gathered wood on the Sabbath was also held in custody until the Lord's will was made known, just like the man who blasphemed God's name
Moses sought God's will in difficult matters and communicated the Lord's decisions to the people
Difficult cases were brought to Moses to receive the Lord's judgment
Moses waited to hear what the Lord would command in unclear situations
Moses presented the case before the Lord when he needed divine guidance
